responsibility: This header defines the public presence of the legacy Break compatibility module for GNU Modula-2's mc-boot runtime. It exports no procedures or data and serves only as an interface placeholder so older source expecting Break can compile against the runtime.
same_name_distinction: Interface-side placeholder for the Break pair: unlike GBreak.cc, it contributes no module body or init/fini code and serves only as the includeable declaration stub for the legacy compatibility module.
